components.name: Point control
components.description: Native SVG in a 48dp touch area. Pressed opacity is 0.55. The outline on keyboard focus is for this browser preview.

components.css: .ds-control { display: block; width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-control svg { display: block; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #F4F6F2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-control:active { opacity: 0.55; } .ds-face { position: relative; width: 225px; height: 225px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 50%; background: #000000; color: #F4F6F2; font-family: sans-serif; } .ds-face .ds-control { position: absolute; top: 43%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } .ds-face .ds-left-plus { left: 12.5%; } .ds-face .ds-right-plus { left: 87.5%; } .ds-face .ds-undo { left: 50%; top: 82.5%; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-face .ds-control:active { opacity: 0.55; } .ds-face .ds-label { position: absolute; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: "tnum"; } .ds-face .ds-points { top: 43%; width: 25%; height: 66px; font-family: "Roboto Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-stretch: condensed; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; } .ds-face .ds-left-points { left: 33.2%; } .ds-face .ds-right-points { left: 66.8%; } .ds-face .ds-separator { left: 50%; top: 43%; width: 7.5%; height: 40px; color: #8B938D; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-face .ds-divider { position: absolute; left: 25%; top: calc(57.5% - 0.375px); width: 50%; height: 0.75px; background: #343936; } .ds-face .ds-games { left: 50%; top: 65.5%; width: 76%; height: 32px; gap: 8px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-face .ds-completed { color: #929B94; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; }

narrative.overview: Condensed bold point scores and filled graphite plus controls lead a black watch face. Current games, completed sets, and a small gray undo arrow sit below. The composition supports a quick glance and a tap on court.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed point numerals hold the strongest visual emphasis.
Fixed touch areas surround compact artwork, leaving the upper watch face open.

rules.name: The score hierarchy rule
rules.body: Points lead; current games are larger and brighter than completed sets. Keep the multiplication separator smaller and dimmer than the points.

rules.name: The touch area rule
rules.body: Keep the fixed control dimensions in the frontmatter when adjusting screen proportions. The artwork is smaller than its touch area.

dos: Do preserve the filled plus controls and condensed bold points as the scoring screen's main row.
Do retain native text fitting, tabular figures, and fixed touch targets when adjusting proportions.
Do keep secondary scoring and undo visually quieter than the points.
donts: Don't add names, menus, banners, extra controls, or a completion screen to this scoring view.
Don't draw a hardware bezel inside the app.
